text:
rebecca.design: quick sync on the batch vectors preview export modal — usability flagged two things: 1) focus gets trapped but there's no visible close affordance, and 2) copying multiple vector IDs via the row actions puts a comma-separated list on clipboard which breaks downstream copy/paste. any thoughts? :thinking:
sam.pm: thanks. for the clipboard issue, is the problem commas or newlines? who reported it?
rebecca.design: support reported customers paste into SQL editors and commas break CSV assumptions. they prefer newline-separated ids.
lin.a11y: newline-separated is better for keyboard workflows. also ensure copy action has aria-live feedback like "Copied 12 vector IDs" and that the copy button is reachable in compact mode.
dave.frontend: easy change: switch join(',') to join('\n') for the copy action. but note CSV export still uses comma delim. we should be explicit about formats in the UI.
sam.pm: UI copy should say "Copy IDs (newline-separated)"? or show small hint under the action?
rebecca.design: I'd rather the hint be inline: small secondary text under the action: "IDs copied as one-per-line". keeps button text short.
lin.a11y: also for the export modal: if focus is trapped, we must provide a clear, focusable close button with aria-label "Close export dialog" and ensure ESC closes it. Screen reader users need that.
dave.frontend: noted. current modal uses role=dialog and focus trap library, but we hid the X button visually in compact view. I'll make it visible and ensure it has aria-describedby linking to the modal header.
rebecca.design: another ask: when users select rows and click export, the modal shows a preview of first 3 rows and a checkbox "include metadata". QA found that when metadata contains commas we don't quote fields in JSON export option. we should add RFC quoting for CSV and proper escaping in JSON strings.
dave.frontend: will add CSV quoting and JSON string escaping. for CSV we can use Papaparse or our util. also add a small switch for delimiter (comma vs tab) in advanced options for enterprise users who paste into Excel.
sam.pm: good idea. keep default comma but allow TSV. copy the filename pattern to include dataset and a short hash to prevent collisions: {project}-{dataset}-{YYYYMMDD}-{rows}-{shortHash}.csv
rebecca.design: please show the exact filename in the modal before export and make it copyable. also allow users to rename before downloading.
lin.a11y: accessibility: when export starts show a role=status live region: "Export in progress: 0%" and update to "Export complete: filename.csv" when done. When progress updates occur, use aria-atomic so screen readers read the changes. Avoid move focus until the download link is available; then move focus to the download link with a brief delay so VO reads the completion.
dave.frontend: implementation plan: modal header -> "Export vectors (24 selected)"; controls: delimiter toggle, include metadata checkbox, filename input (pre-filled), Export button; progress bar with aria-valuemin/valuemax/valuenow; live region for announcements. I'll add data-testids for QA.
sam.pm: product question: default to "include metadata" or not? analytics show users often want metadata included.
rebecca.design: default ON but remember it in local storage per user. show a small toast: "Remember export preferences? [Yes] [No]" after first export.
lin.a11y: ensure the toast is announced but not intrusive (role=status). Also keyboard users should be able to dismiss toast.
export-helper-bot: export-check: csv-quoting: PASS; clipboard-format: WARN (comma-separated detected in previous run).
dave.frontend: I'll fix clipboard join and CSV quoting in the same PR. ETA tomorrow EOD.
rebecca.design: can we also add a tiny help link to docs explaining formats and how to import into Excel/BigQuery? users keep asking.
sam.pm: yes, add link and log clicks for that help link.
dave.frontend: will attach PR with screenshots and accessibility notes. pinging @lin.a11y for validation once up.
lin.a11y: will run keyboard + VO checks, and test focus trapping, close button, live region behaviour. if anything else, I'll post small follow-ups.
sam.pm: thanks all. aim to ship in the next patch. :rocket:
